fields.custom_premise: Two lighthouse keepers must get a warning bell working before a ferry enters the fog.
fields.story_characters: Mara, a woman in her thirties, and Jon, a man in his forties. Only these two characters speak, apart from the announcer.
fields.story_plot: They find a jammed bell mechanism, disagree about the repair, then work together to sound the warning. The ferry turns safely away. No supernatural explanation.
fields.story_setting: An isolated coastal lighthouse in the 1930s, during one stormy night.
